methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $43M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
FleetZero is a Series A transportation company founded by Steven Henderson and Mike Carter that has raised $43M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 8 private companies in the transportation sector, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and REGENT Craft; no public transportation comparables were available for direct benchmarking.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation technique. Using FleetZero's $43M total raised as a baseline proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-Series B transitions, this method implies a valuation of $86M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied given insufficient narrow-filter matches within the same stage and adjacent valuation tiers—only 3 total sector peers exist, and none met the minimum three-datapoint threshold for the same or adjacent stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $73M (low) to $99M (high), with a median of $86M. This relatively tight band reflects reliance on a single validated method. Key uncertainties include the applicability of standard step-up multipliers in frontier transportation, where market dynamics and capital intensity differ materially from conventional software or services comps. A broader private peer dataset at comparable stages would strengthen confidence in the range.
